title: Spicy Fried Rice
description: A flavorful and spicy fried rice dish made with a blend of Indian spices and American-style fried rice. Serve as a main course or side dish.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add scallions and cook until they start to soften, about 2 minutes.
Add Indian spices and adventurous spice blend (if using) and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add fried rice and stir to combine with spices.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Serve hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
